name: Toyou Feiji Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Toyou Feiji Electronics Co., Ltd. operates as an enterprise-level professional storage manufacturer in China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. The company offers flash memory, independent and controllable, enterprise and distributed storage, and storage network products. It serves government agencies, financial telecommunications, scientific research institutes, transportation and medical care, public protection and law departments, energy manufacturing, smart cities, and educational media. Toyou Feiji Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
